recs.x:
You could start by just calculating the potential energy of the volume of the tank you are considering, and the difference in elevation between the reservoirs (volume x 1 kg/L x gravity x elevation difference, plug in the units of your choice and let google figure it out).

I suspect the amount of energy is far less than you are imagining... It takes a lot of water to generate a useful amount of energy. This video ( [link] ) does an interesting demo and points out that a 5 gallon bucket on a ladder has the same potential energy as a watch battery.
